The vendor directly providing the software product **Novoresume** at **novoresume.com** is **Novorésumé ApS**.

### Evidence
According to the official **Terms of Use** and **Privacy Policy** published on `novoresume.com`:
> *"Novorésumé is a product of Novorésumé ApS, meaning that the Terms of Use found below applies to Novorésumé. When there is a reference to „Novorésumé”, „us” or „we” this takes into account the following: novoresume.com, Novorésumé ApS, website, site or any other application/app/service/software directly related to Novorésumé and owned & developed by Novorésumé."*
